The '''Glythe sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], situated near the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]] between the [[Droma sector/Legends|Droma sector]] and the [[Haldeen sector/Legends|Haldeen sector]]. It was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and, after the rise of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] within the sector included [[Altarrn]], [[Fef]], [[Fornax/Legends|Fornax]], [[Nentan]], [[Vortex/Legends|Vortex]], and [[Valrar]].

[[Field agent]] [[Sheedup]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] operated in the Glythe sector for decades.<ref name="SWG:SaRr">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal|Imperial|Strike a Rebel refinery}}</ref>

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] incorrectly places [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]], [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]], [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]], and [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] in Glythe sector. Elrood is in [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]; Arkania is in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]; Yag'Dhul is in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]; [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] is in the [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]].
